scholarships.title: Programa de patrocinios del Banco de la República para estudios de posgrado en el exterior
scholarships.official_source: Banco de la República (Central Bank of Colombia)

existing.description: The Banco de la República sponsors postgraduate study at foreign institutions of recognised academic excellence for Colombian professionals, and the programme is organised by discipline rather than as one open call. The lines named on the official programme page are doctoral study in economics, master's degrees in public administration and public policy, a postgraduate qualification in economic law, and patronage of individual young talent in plastic arts and in music. The arts line is described as open to plastic-arts professionals wishing to study painting, sculpture, printmaking, drawing, photography, performance, installations and new digital media and audiovisual technology.
eligibility: Colombian professionals (the programme page lists the patronage lines for Colombian applicants)
Admission to, or application for, a postgraduate programme at a foreign university of recognised academic excellence
For the arts line: plastic-arts professionals seeking study in painting, sculpture, printmaking, drawing, photography, performance, installations, new (digital) media and audiovisual technology
For the music line: professionals who demonstrate artistic merits and qualities
For the economic-law line: a law professional seeking a master's or doctorate in economic law
For the economics line: five places for a doctorate in economics, and/or master's degrees in public administration or public policy
existing.eligibility_summary: Colombian professionals, including academics, whose proposed postgraduate study is at a foreign university of recognised excellence; each line has its own cupos, reference lists and merit criteria.
benefits: Sponsorship of an overseas postgraduate programme in a listed discipline
Up to five doctoral places in economics
Master's places in public administration and public policy
One place for economic law (master's or doctorate)
Young-talent patronage for plastic arts and for music
coverage: Postgraduate study sponsorship at the foreign institution (programme fees for the sponsored years)
Multiple years of support for doctoral study (up to the fourth year of the programme)
requirements: Study at a university appearing on the line's published reference list of universities and programmes
Create an account on the Banco de la República postgraduate sponsorship platform
Complete and submit the sponsorship application electronically
documents: The Banco de la República page instructs applicants to follow the 'Instructivo de postulación para patrocinio de estudios en el exterior', which was not rendered in the page read
application_method: Step 1: create an account to access the 'Patrocinio posgrados' platform
Step 3: submit the application and track it on the platform
existing.selection_notes: The programme page states the purpose is to support creative processes for outstanding professionals who demonstrate artistic merit in the arts lines, and for economics and law it is restricted to the reference lists published for each line.
existing.best_fit: Colombian professionals in economics, law, public administration, plastic arts or music who hold or are applying to a place at a listed foreign institution of recognised excellence.
existing.notes: Each discipline line has its own reference list of universities (for example the music line lists Freiburg and Cologne in Germany, McGill in Canada, and Curtis, Eastman, Cleveland Institute of Music, Indiana, Johns Hopkins in the United States; the economic-law line lists Harvard, Oxford, Cambridge, Yale, Stanford and LSE). Reference lists for recent cycles are dated 2022-2023 in places, so the current list must be re-checked with the bank each cycle.
existing.duration: Doctoral sponsorship runs up to a maximum of the fourth year of the overseas programme; the economic-law patronage covers a master's or doctorate up to the second or fourth year according to the programme
existing.application_period: Annual cycle announced by news item on the programme page (most recent read: 15 December 2025 for the 2026 cycle); the arts-plastics line states the call opens in the second half of 2026 and the economic-law line is offered from the second half of 2026
